statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans, it satisfies len(ans) = n and, for every i with 0 <= i < n, ans[i] = max { min { nums[j+k] | 0 <= k <= i } | 0 <= j <= n-1-i }. Here the inner min is the minimum of the contiguous subarray nums[j], nums[j+1], ..., nums[j+i], and the outer max is over all contiguous subarrays of nums of length i+1.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans, len(ans) = n.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans; it does not fail.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, for every i with 0 <= i < n, min_{0 <= k < n} nums[k] <= ans[i] <= max_{0 <= k < n} nums[k].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, for every i with 0 <= i < n and every j with 0 <= j <= n-1-i, min_{0 <= k <= i} nums[j+k] <= ans[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, for every i with 0 <= i < n, there exists j with 0 <= j <= n-1-i such that ans[i] = min_{0 <= k <= i} nums[j+k].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, ans[0] = max_{0 <= k < n} nums[k].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, ans[n-1] = min_{0 <= k < n} nums[k].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, for every i and j with 0 <= i <= j < n, ans[i] >= ans[j].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, for every i with 0 <= i < n, there exists k with 0 <= k < n such that ans[i] = nums[k].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, for every i with 0 <= i < n and every integer t, ans[i] >= t if and only if there exists j with 0 <= j <= n-1-i such that for every k with 0 <= k <= i, nums[j+k] >= t.
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, for every i with 0 <= i < n, ans[i] = nums[n-1-i].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n. Additionally, nums is nondecreasing: nums[k] <= nums[k+1] for every k with 0 <= k < n-1.

statement: Whenever find_maximums(nums) returns a result ans with len(ans) = n, for every i with 0 <= i < n, ans[i] = nums[i].
preconditions: Let n = len(nums). The slice satisfies n >= 1, n <= 100000, and 0 <= nums[k] <= 1000000000 for every k with 0 <= k < n. Additionally, nums is nonincreasing: nums[k] >= nums[k+1] for every k with 0 <= k < n-1.
